SELECT count(*) FROM (
  SELECT sa.id_student
  FROM studentAssessment sa
  JOIN assessments a ON sa.id_assessment = a.id_assessment
  WHERE a.code_module = 'BBB' AND a.code_presentation = '2013J' AND a.assessment_type = 'TMA'
  GROUP BY sa.id_student
  HAVING count(DISTINCT sa.id_assessment) = (
    SELECT count(*) FROM assessments 
    WHERE code_module = 'BBB' AND code_presentation = '2013J' AND assessment_type = 'TMA'
  )
)
